ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and as isolated spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling located at the distal tips of both lobes. Specific high-intensity circular markers located at approximately 1/4 width of the left lobe and near the center-right of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge. A notable deep, non-periodic U-shaped indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the central notch to the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white pixels at both extreme tips (lateral margins). Isolated circular 'ring' scars visible on the dark pigmentation of the mid-left and upper-center fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct deep indentation or nick on the trailing edge of the left lobe, mid-way between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'donut-shaped' white markings scattered across the primary dark ventral surface.
